answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by binding each new identity to a non-exportable enclave and a refundable admission bond that stays locked until that identity completes unique graded work. A farm cannot reuse one falcon-class attestor: every clone needs its own mesa of hardware and must park capital in the vesting meadow for the full waiting window. Attacker cost therefore scales with headcount, hardware plus locked bond per fake, instead of collapsing to a single shared key.
